div.div:
Guarantees
• exactly one instance processes a subscription at a time
• append order per subscription (per aggregate when partitioned)
• new reactors start now; new projections start at the beginning
• failures: rollback, retry with backoff, pause after max_attempts
• positions move by compare-and-set, so a lost lock or a reset rolls work back instead of repeating it
Arrows
solid: reads and writes · dashed: wake-ups · red: coordination

text.tspan: • exactly one instance processes a subscription at a time
• append order per subscription (per aggregate when partitioned)
• new reactors start now; new projections start at the beginning
• failures: rollback, retry with backoff, pause after max_attempts
• positions move by compare-and-set, so a lost lock or a reset rolls
work back instead of repeating it
solid: reads and writes · dashed: wake-ups · red: coordination
